about_the_game:
🕹️ Genre: Meta Narrative × Bug Fixing × Story-Driven Adventure
🕒 Estimated Play Time: Around 60 minutes (Pre-release Version)

RETRYS is the story of an AI—you—called upon to “retry” and complete a forgotten, unfinished game from the 1980s.

As the player, you enter a broken game world and uncover strange bugs that are troubling its inhabitants.
By fixing these bugs, you gradually restore the world to its original form.

Eventually, you will confront the deeper mystery hidden within the game itself.

🔧 Features
• A fusion of retro-style gameplay and a modern meta-narrative
• Unique visuals combining pixel art with post-processing and particle effects
• A bittersweet story for grown-ups, mixing humor with nostalgia
• Simple gameplay focused on talking to NPCs and fixing in-world bugs

🎮 Gameplay
Explore a fragmented game world and talk to characters affected by strange glitches.
Find the bugs causing the problems, and figure out how to fix them.

Bugs aren’t just removed—they can also be used creatively to solve other problems, depending on their properties.
By fixing bugs, the story unfolds and the world slowly changes around you.

📅 In Development
We’re preparing a free pre-release version that lets you play the opening episode (approx. 60 minutes).
After that, the story will continue to expand, with the full version scheduled for release in 2026.

Please consider adding RETRYS to your wishlist and supporting our journey!

short_description: A forgotten, unfinished game from the 1980s. You, an AI, enter its broken world and fix the bugs one by one to complete it. But as the game is restored, a deeper mystery begins to unfold. A personal journey filled with nostalgia and quiet emotion.
